title: Graph-Recurrent Learning of Emergent Collective Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.31350v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Collective ordering in correlated electron systems emerges from microscopic dynamics, yet the evolution of observable textures need not admit a closed, memoryless description. We introduce a graph-recurrent neural network (GRNN) framework that learns such emergent dynamics directly from trajectories without specifying microscopic equations of motion. The framework integrates gated recurrent memory with graph message passing: local hidden states encode information beyond the instantaneous observables, while spatial coupling allows this information to propagate between sites. The observable and hidden fields evolve jointly through a shared local rule, providing a scalable representation of dynamics with spatial interactions and temporal memory. translated_title: 涌现集体动力学的图-循环学习
translated_abstract: 关联电子系统中的集体有序性源自微观动力学，然而可观测纹理的演化未必容许一个封闭的、无记忆的描述。我们引入了一个图-循环神经网络（GRNN）框架，该框架直接从轨迹中学习此类涌现动力学，而无需指定微观运动方程。该框架将门控循环记忆与图消息传递相结合：局部隐状态编码了超出瞬时可观测量的信息，而空间耦合使这些信息能够在格点之间传播。可观测场与隐场通过共享的局部规则共同演化，为具有空间相互作用和时间记忆的动力学提供了可扩展的表示。我们在半经典 Holstein 模型中电荷密度波有序的涌现动力学上验证了该框架，成功再现了时间与空间关联以及动力学结……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将门控循环记忆与图消息传递相结合的图-循环神经网络（GRNN）框架，能够在无需已知微观运动方程的情况下直接从轨迹中学习关联电子系统的涌现集体动力学，并在半经典 Holstein 模型的电荷密度波动力学上成功再现了时空关联等动力学行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a graph-recurrent neural network (GRNN) framework combining gated recurrent memory with graph message passing, which learns emergent collective dynamics directly from trajectories without specifying microscopic equations of motion, and is validated on charge-density-wave dynamics in the semiclassical Holstein model.
